entities.name: pale mat awning over the shed

entities.vis: full
entities.note: Probably the mat roof of the shed below it (then the structures agent's building; drop this). Its painted corners (in the air): W (2650,627), N (2750,513), E (2920,610), S (2803,700). Base taken at the shed's front line under its S corner. MERGE: the structures pass sees the same awning on a post at u 2648-2656 (awning 2650-2920, v 548-705) and did not record a building under it; it may be the incense shop's south porch.

Casks: near (south) cask top ellipse u 2705-2840, v 1480-1520, lid knob (2770,1498); far cask u 2770-2900, v 1440-1463, knob (2837,1452); basket u 2707-2790, v 1520-1597. Under the rear a curved frame and a post reach the ground at (2748,1685) (a rear prop or a small rear wheel, unclear). SCALE: big wheel rim u 2845-2935, v 1460-1690, hub (2890,1547): 230 px tall; cask lid 135 px across; bed about 240 px long (u 2700-2940).
